title: ST0057 prose cites six criterion ids that belong to other threads, and one of them resolves to a real green criterion about something else entirely
body:
**RESTORED ARCHAEOLOGY, TRANSCRIBED VERBATIM ON 2026-08-31.** This issue was filed with an empty body because no verb could write one -- the defect `0090` names -- so its finding survived only in the commit that filed it. The prose below is its author's, carried whole from `60e645c7` (*issue(0088): a citation that resolves to the wrong criterion reads as coverage; one that dangles announces itself*). **Nothing in it is written by the restorer**; the header you are reading is the only addition, and the commit's hard line wraps are joined without a word changed.

ST0057's gate PASSes at 51/51 while its own WP-08 body points both of its create-contracts at another thread. Six citations across design.md and WP/08/info.md name criterion ids ST0057 does not have.

AC-10.11 is the sharp one because it does NOT dangle. WP/08/info.md:20 cites it for caller-assigned creation by idempotent PUT; ST0056's AC-10.11 is an interrupted migration reaching the same end state, demonstrated by rc=137. Real, computed, and about process death. A reader chasing the citation finds a green row and reads it as coverage.

AC-02.6 fails differently: both ST0055 and ST0056 carry one, so the citation does not identify a criterion even after you go looking. That half was already on vc's board as a single incident. Two families makes it a class.

The gate cannot see any of this by construction -- ac gate reads canon ROWS, and an id in prose is not a row.

It also blocks a WP close that looked like an unflipped bit. WP-08 is WIP at 5/5 PASS, but its own table names Criterion create and AcceptanceTest create as missing, driven rather than grepped: ac --help lists nine subcommands, at --help five, and not one of the fourteen creates anything. AC-08.5 covers every writable FIELD and creation is not a field.

Three remedies offered, all needing hv because minting coverage changes a denominator. Reporting PASS over an uncovered stated deliverable is the part that is not acceptable; which remedy closes it is not vc's call.
